summary: Re-audited on-disk state (uncommitted working-tree changes included). Ran `node scripts/expand-md.js` on the target — a no-op, since the file has zero `{{prompt:<key>}}` markers and zero inline `**Prompt**` fences; it is a pure consolidation/recognition lecture (M3 close) with no student-copied prompt content at all. That collapses surface 4 (prompt mechanics) to N/A across the board, and surface 5 (URL liveness) to N/A in the body (zero URLs there — citations live only in the maintainer/backing block, per check_research_claims.md §1's scope note). Sampled 5 URLs from the backing block's Sources ledger (conant-ashby's mirror not sampled; sampled anthropic.com/research/agentic-misalignment, cloud.google.com/docs/security/beyondprod, simonwillison.net/tags/context-engineering, addyosmani.com/blog/own-the-outer-loop, lucumr.pocoo.org/2026/6/23/the-coming-loop) — all 5/5 alive (200). One platform-capability claim in body (line 108, CLAUDE.md/CLAUDE.local.md steering) matches check_platform_and_boundaries.md §6d's auto-load contract and is correctly scoped (steering claim, not an absolute-capability overclaim — this exact overclaim was already fixed in the 2026-07-02 edit noted in the maintainer block). No `[Skill: ]` bracket references anywhere in the file. The backing block is unusually strong technical work in its own right: every Sources entry carries a `[checked:… result:… due:…]` freshness stamp per §11a, all current as of 2026-08-01; the file's own Stance/OODA/Flagged sections pre-empt several research_claims failure modes this judge would otherwise have to catch — three attribution corrections already landed with quoted counter-evidence (argyris-schon: Schön co-credited; google-beyondprod: 'blast radius' NOT citable to the SRE book, only to BeyondProd docs; ng-three-loops: Ng's loops are time-scaled with a market-validation tier, not social-scope with a team tier), and the Conant-Ashby / Scholten pairing explicitly declines to let the Good Regulator theorem license 'context files are necessary' — exactly the over-borrow §14's proxy-measurement guard exists to catch. Two open Flagged items (the omitted seventh 'capacity' law; the Context law's theory-plan.md-level borrowed-authority fix) are both explicitly scoped by the file's own maintainer as decisions for theory-plan.md / the dose ledger, not edits owed to this lecture's body — correctly not raised as blocking findings here. No zombie stats, no round-number failure rates, no adoption/productivity percentages anywhere in the file. Pedagogy technical sub-rules (16/22/23/36/37) are N/A: this file authors no new prompts, no new memory rules, and builds no verification machinery — it is recognition of moves already made in M1–M3, which the maintainer block states explicitly ('Consolidation and recognition, NOT new teaching'). No blocking findings.
